tips.heading: Tips
tips.prompt.text.title: Add text to the canvas
tips.prompt.text.body: To label a set of browsers or leave a note, ask in chat. The agent writes it on the canvas, beside the browser. Your code does not change.
tips.prompt.text.try1: Add a heading above these: Checkout
tips.prompt.text.try2: Add a note beside Pricing: the hero is cramped
tips.prompt.text.try3: Label each browser by what it shows
tips.prompt.routes.title: Open every page
tips.prompt.routes.blurb: Each page of your site in its own browser.
tips.prompt.routes.body: To see your whole site at once, ask for every page. The agent finds your routes and opens each page in its own browser, in a grid.
tips.prompt.routes.try1: Open the settings pages side by side
tips.prompt.routes.try3: Open the signup pages in order, left to right
tips.prompt.vars.title: Make variations
tips.prompt.vars.blurb: New versions of a design, beside the original.
tips.prompt.vars.body: To compare ideas, ask for variations. Say what to change and by how much. Each variation opens in its own browser, beside the original.
tips.prompt.vars.try1: Make two variations of the hero
tips.prompt.vars.try2: Make a denser and a roomier pricing table
tips.prompt.vars.try3: Make a variation with a serif headline
tips.prompt.ds.title: Make a design system
tips.prompt.ds.blurb: Your colors, type and components on one page.
tips.prompt.ds.body: To see your styles in one place, ask for a design system. The agent reads your code and builds a page with your colors, type and components.
tips.prompt.ds.try1: Make a design system from this app
tips.prompt.ds.try2: Show every button and input in the app
tips.prompt.ds.try3: Show our colors and type on one page
tips.prompt.page.title: Add a canvas page
tips.prompt.page.blurb: A separate canvas page for new work.
tips.prompt.page.body: To keep new work apart, ask for a canvas page. The agent adds it, names it and puts the new browsers there. Your other canvas pages do not change.
tips.prompt.page.try1: Add a canvas page for the checkout flow
tips.prompt.page.try2: Add a canvas page for mobile designs
tips.prompt.page.try3: Move these browsers to a canvas page named Onboarding
tips.prompt.compare.title: Compare before and after
tips.prompt.compare.blurb: The original and the change, side by side.
tips.prompt.compare.body: To judge a change, ask to keep the original. The agent shows the new version in a browser beside it.
tips.prompt.compare.try1: Keep the original and show the change beside it
tips.prompt.compare.try2: Show the old and new navigation side by side
tips.prompt.mobile.title: Design for mobile
tips.prompt.mobile.blurb: Phone and tablet sizes, beside desktop.
tips.prompt.mobile.body: To check how a layout responds, ask for other screen sizes. The agent opens phone and tablet browsers beside the desktop one.
tips.prompt.mobile.try2: Show Pricing at tablet and phone sizes
tips.prompt.tidy.title: Organize the canvas
tips.prompt.tidy.blurb: Align browsers and label each one.
tips.prompt.tidy.body: To make the canvas easier to read, ask the agent to organize it. It aligns the browsers, adds a title above each one and removes overlaps.
tips.prompt.tidy.try1: Organize the canvas and label each browser
tips.prompt.tidy.try2: Put each flow in its own row
tips.prompt.ref.title: Match a reference
tips.prompt.ref.blurb: Paste an image to use as a reference.
tips.prompt.ref.body: To make a page look like an image, paste the image in chat. It can be a screenshot, a mockup or a sketch. The agent changes your code to match its layout, spacing and style.
tips.prompt.ref.try1: Make this page look like the reference
tips.prompt.ref.try2: Make the hero match this reference
tips.prompt.ref.try3: Build this sketch as a page
tips.prompt.refLayout.title: Copy a layout
tips.prompt.refLayout.blurb: Use the structure of a reference.
tips.prompt.refLayout.body: To reuse a layout you like, paste a screenshot of it. The agent rebuilds your page with the same columns, sidebar and sections, and keeps your content and components.
tips.prompt.refLayout.try1: Use the layout in this reference
tips.prompt.refLayout.try2: Use this dashboard layout for my home page
tips.prompt.refLayout.try3: Lay out Pricing like this reference
tips.prompt.refColor.title: Use colors from an image
tips.prompt.refColor.blurb: Get a palette from a photo or a logo.
tips.prompt.refColor.body: To match a brand or a mood, paste an image as a reference. The agent takes its colors and applies them to your app, through your design tokens if you have them.
tips.prompt.refColor.try1: Use the colors in this reference
tips.prompt.refColor.try2: Make a palette from this photo
tips.prompt.refColor.try3: Use our brand colors from this logo
tips.prompt.empty.title: Show empty and error states
tips.prompt.empty.blurb: See screens that are hard to reach.
tips.prompt.empty.body: To design every state of a page, ask for them. The agent opens the page with data, with no data and with an error, side by side.
tips.prompt.empty.try1: Show this page with no data and with an error
tips.prompt.empty.try2: Show the dashboard for a new user
tips.prompt.empty.try3: Show checkout when the payment fails
tips.prompt.flow.title: Show a flow
tips.prompt.flow.blurb: Each step of a journey, in order.
tips.prompt.flow.body: To see a journey from start to end, name it. The agent opens each step in its own browser, left to right, in the order a user goes through them.
tips.prompt.flow.try1: Show the signup flow, step by step
tips.prompt.flow.try2: Show checkout from cart to confirmation
tips.prompt.flow.try3: Show onboarding in order, left to right
tips.prompt.harmonize.title: Make elements match
tips.prompt.harmonize.blurb: Fix two elements that should look the same.
tips.prompt.harmonize.body: To fix elements that should match but do not, select both. The agent gives them the same shape, spacing, type and color.
tips.prompt.harmonize.try3: Make these buttons look the same
tips.prompt.states.title: Show every state
tips.prompt.states.blurb: Hover, pressed, focused and disabled, side by side.
tips.prompt.states.body: To check each state of an element, select it and ask. The agent opens a browser that shows it at rest, on hover, pressed, focused, disabled and loading.
tips.prompt.states.try1: Show this button disabled and loading
tips.prompt.states.try2: Show every state of this input
tips.prompt.states.try3: Show every state of this button
tips.prompt.showcase.title: Explore a component
tips.prompt.showcase.blurb: Sizes, layouts and styles of one component.
tips.prompt.showcase.body: To choose how a component should look, select it and ask for options. The agent opens a browser with that component in different sizes, layouts and styles.
tips.prompt.showcase.try1: Show this card in other sizes and layouts
tips.prompt.showcase.try2: Show this card in a horizontal layout
tips.prompt.showcase.try3: Show three styles for this section
